svg.title: Item Class Reconstruction status and recovery class Reflection positivity and rooted bounds C Lifted with identical Gram matrices on the retained probe algebra. Activity domains, budgets, norm (AB1–AB12) C, D Definitions supplied; frame-blind flags, ordered- derivative recovery and isometry of the activity chart are new (Prop. 9.1, Thms. 9.2, 9.4). Exact embedding with section. Quadratic history contract C Five-row identities lifted through d1p (Prop. 11.1); amendment recorded as a retained choice. Primitive integrand (PRI1– PRI9) C Regrouping is a bijection; marginal extension loses only unread coordinates (Props. 13.3, 13.5). Stationary graph (AS, US) C, D Graph and response bounds supplied; recovery of the vertical discrepancy from the residual with period-free constants is new (Thm. 14.5). On-shell recovery with explicit off-shell defect. Exterior division, two-leg prim- itive (ED, TEL) C Division is a section of contraction; primitive not unique (Props. 14.8, Thm. 14.9). Loop moments (LM) C Quiet families are the zero fibre of an additive moment readout (Prop. 14.10). One-loop drift and s = 11CA/(24π2) (DR, DP, MA) C Coefficient derived inside the supplied construction from an exact pole integral (arithmetic recomputed here); actual couplings tied to the reference clock by inequality (Thm. 14.12). Not a physical-coupling identification. Common calendar (CAL) C One common witness for all histories, cutoffs, periods, observables (Thm. 14.16); non-unique, monotone un- der admissible enlargement. Startup representative (SQ, FST) C Exact density identity with nonzero activities (Thm. 14.18); evaluation reader many-to-one. Forward recipe and shooting (FCA, RSP, FCC, RET) C, B Operation lift with zero defect (Thm. 14.20); cali- brated histories exist (Thm. 14.24); calibration is im- posed at the bottom and propagated. Beacons, reference chart (RB, PL, GL, RBG) C Controlled approximation with stated rates; con- stants tied to fixed reference tori. Activity norm, step maps (LCN, ASP) C Descent of step maps to the common chart (Thm. 14.28). Stability and running (FCB, RUN) C Bottom reader injective and Lipschitz-invertible within the retained recipe (Thm. 14.29); slope clause of the public theorem recovered (RUN5). Protected variables (PV) C, D Reading as a horizontal lift with equivariance under the frame action is new. Path books (SH) C Full-sequence limits for quadratic rows, subsequential for nonlinear books (Prop. 15.3). Radial jets (RJ) C, D Curl/radial reconstruction supplied; explicit gauge pa- rameter and fibre description are new (Thm. 16.1).
